Who treats you

Our Team

Marla Liberatore

Master Nurse Aesthetic Injector - Owner

Meet Marla, Founder of Pout Aesthetics Marla Liberatore, RN, is the founder of Pout Aesthetics, but her story in medicine began long before Pout ever had a name. Marla started her nursing career at the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, where she developed the compassion, attention to detail, and patient-first approach that would become the foundation of her career. From there, she transitioned into reproductive medicine and infertility, helping patients through some of the most emotional and deeply personal moments of their lives. But Marla always had another dream: plastic surgery and aesthetics. She eventually took the leap into plastics, where she had the opportunity to train and work alongside one of New Jersey’s most highly sought-after plastic surgeons. It was there that she fell in love with the artistry of aesthetics—the ability to combine medicine, anatomy, creativity, and an eye for detail to help someone feel like the best version of themselves. Then came Pout. Pout Aesthetics didn’t begin with a huge team, investors, or a perfect business plan. It began with Marla, a wish, a dream, and the belief that she could create something different. She started Pout on her own and built it patient by patient, never losing sight of what she wanted it to feel like: welcoming, personal, fun, and elevated—while still delivering results rooted in education, safety, and anatomy. Today, Pout has grown into far more than she imagined in those early days, but Marla remains deeply involved in the practice and continues to treat her patients with the same personal approach that helped build it. Outside of Pout, Marla’s greatest accomplishment is her family. She is the proud mom of four children—three boys and one daughter—and, of course, Tank, her English Bulldog, who absolutely believes he deserves equal billing. For Marla, Pout is more than an aesthetics practice. It’s proof that sometimes the things you build from nothing but a wish, a little courage, and a really big dream can become more than you ever imagined. She combines advanced treatments with personalized care to help clients achieve clearer, healthier, more confident skin. Dedicated, knowledgeable, and client focused, Elliana is here to guide you on your journey to your best skin yet!

Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

A few things clients often want to know before their appointment.

Do I need a consultation before treatment? +

Yes. Every service starts with a consultation so we can talk through what you want, what is realistic, and what treatment options may be appropriate for you.

Can I choose a specific injector? +

Yes. You can book with a specific member of the POUT team when scheduling your appointment.

What services does POUT Aesthetics offer? +

Our services include lip filler, lip flip, tox, dermal filler, facial balancing, customized facials, and other aesthetic services. Visit our Services page for full details.

Explore our services
Can I see results before booking? +

Yes. Visit our Before & After section to view results from different services and treatment areas.

View before & after
Where is POUT Aesthetics located? +

POUT Aesthetics is located at 611 Berlin–Cross Keys Rd, B-218, Sicklerville, NJ 08081.

How do I book an appointment? +

You can use the Book Now button on the website to open the appointment calendar and choose an available time.

Our Services

Everything here starts with a consult. We talk through what you want to change, what's realistic, and what it involves — then you decide.

01
Lip Filler

Volume, shape and balance. The lips are mapped first and the plan is agreed before treatment begins.

Focus Volume, shape & balance Plan Half syringe, full syringe or gradual build Time 45 min Settles Around 2 weeks
02
Lip Flip

A subtle treatment focused on the upper lip. No filler is involved, making it a smaller change for clients wanting a more understated result.

Focus Upper lip Type Tox · no filler Time 15 min Results 3–7 days
03
Tox

Personalized placement for common expression areas, with the plan designed to soften movement while keeping your expression looking like you.

Areas Forehead · elevens · crow's feet Approach Personalized placement Time 30 min Results 3–14 days
04
Dermal Filler

Filler treatments planned around facial proportions. Placement is conservative and larger plans may be built gradually across visits.

Areas Cheeks · chin · jawline · under-eye Approach Conservative, gradual build Time 45–60 min Results Visible immediately
05
Facial Balancing

A full-face approach instead of focusing on only one feature. The face is mapped during consultation and a personalized plan is created around overall proportions.

Focus Full-face proportions Planning Mapped during consultation Consult 60 min Treatment Can be staged
06
Facials

Customized facial services selected around your individual skin-care needs and goals.

Focus Individual skin-care needs Plan Customized to the client Time 30–45 min Visit Same day
07
Liquid Lipo Injections

Targeted injections intended for specific areas of the body. The treatment area and plan are discussed individually before proceeding.

Focus Specific targeted areas Plan Personalized by treatment area

Privacy Policy

This page explains how POUT Aesthetics handles information collected through the website, forms, and booking links.

What we collect

We may collect contact details you submit through forms, appointment requests, and messages, along with basic usage data such as browser type, device size, and page visits.

How we use it

Information is used to respond to inquiries, manage appointments, improve the website, and support client communication. If you book through an external calendar, that platform may also collect and store your data under its own terms.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share data with service providers that help operate the site, booking flow, analytics, or communications.

Your choices

You can contact us to update or remove information where applicable. If you no longer want messages, follow the opt-out instructions in the message or contact the studio directly.

Contact

For privacy questions, reach out through the contact details listed on the site.
